name: How long does a slow drain repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a slow drain repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a slow drain repair can vary. Simple clogs addressed with snaking might take an hour or two. More complex issues requiring camera inspection, hydro-jetting, or main line work could take longer, potentially a few hours or, in rare cases, a full day for extensive repairs. We aim to complete repairs efficiently while ensuring the problem is resolved thoroughly, minimizing disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; simple clogs take 1-2 hours, while complex issues like main line work can take several hours or longer.
